Team.title: Team
Team.description: Everyone in {name}, their role and the tools they use. Invite people and change their access here.
Team.readOnly: Everyone in {name} and the tools they use. Only the owner and admins can invite people or change access.
Team.failedBody: Check your connection and try again.
Team.emptyBody: Invite your colleagues so they can use the workspace's tools.

errors.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can make someone an admin.

roleWhat.admin: {name} will be able to invite people and change their access, but not billing.
roleWhat.member: {name} will use the tools they have access to and won't manage the team.
roleWhat.guest: {name} will see only what's shared with them.

impact.seatsSame: Purchased quantities and charges stay the same. Access assignments may change.
impact.withdraw: The invitation sent to {email} stops working. You can invite them again later.
impact.remove: {name} loses access to {workspace} and all its tools straight away.
impact.releases: Assigned seats and pending reservations are released; purchased capacity stays the same.

seats.title: Seats and access
seats.modelB: Purchased seats are separate from assigned people and invitation reservations. Guests also use a seat on tools billed per user.
seats.linesNote: Only a separate seat purchase changes the quantity billed. Invitations and access changes use existing capacity.
seats.noLines: No supported tool is subscribed yet. Purchase a tool before assigning access.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.body: Invite them to {name} through the mock mailbox. A seat is reserved for each selected tool.
invite.adminOwnerOnly: Only the owner can make someone an admin.
invite.roleAdmin: Invites people and changes their access. No billing.
invite.roleMember: Uses the tools you give them access to.
invite.roleGuest: Restricted review access. HR is unavailable; Chats guests join meetings only. Seats still use the tool’s capacity.

errors.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can make someone an admin. Choose another role, or ask the owner.
errors.taken: This person is already in the workspace or invited.
errors.email: Enter an email address like name@company.com.
errors.tools: Choose a supported tool with available capacity. Purchase or release a seat if none is available.

invite.sentReserved: Stored in the mock mailbox. Existing capacity is reserved; no charge or purchased quantity changed.
invite.uncertain: The invitation result wasn’t confirmed. Its original details are kept. Check the result before sending another invitation.
invite.sentMembership: Stored in the mock mailbox. Workspace membership is invited; tool access can be assigned separately.

access.label: Tool access
access.allHint: Supported tools subscribed now. Tools added later require a separate access change.

accessDialog.title: Tool access for {name}
accessDialog.body: Choose which of the workspace's tools they can open.
accessDialog.impactSame: Assign or release existing capacity. Purchased quantities and charges stay the same.
accessDialog.errorEmpty: Choose a supported tool with available capacity.
accessDialog.pending: Accept or cancel the invitation before editing this member’s access.
accessDialog.capacity: One or more selected tools have no available seat. Release or purchase capacity first.

cost.guestBody: Guests have restricted access but still occupy a seat on tools billed per user.
cost.title: Uses existing capacity
cost.when: Inviting reserves capacity now. Acceptance converts that reservation to assigned access once, with no additional charge.
cost.blocked: A selected tool has no available seat. Purchase or release capacity before inviting.
cost.membershipBody: No tool seat is reserved. Tool access must be assigned separately after they join.

invitationList.title: Invitations
invitationList.uncertain: The result wasn’t confirmed. Retry the original action to check before doing anything else.

ownership.title: Transfer workspace ownership
ownership.body: Choose an active member to own {workspace}.
ownership.review: {name} becomes the owner. You become an admin and keep your existing tool access.
ownership.seats: Ownership does not assign a tool seat. Existing capacity, assignments and charges stay the same.
ownership.empty: An active member must join before ownership can be transferred. Guests cannot own a workspace.
ownership.unconfirmed: The handover result is unconfirmed. The original person and request are kept. Check that result before attempting another handover.
ownership.workspaceChanged: Return to the original workspace to review or recover this handover.
